writing.overall_comment: A well-organized, accurate architecture skill with good tradeoff framing, though it would be more actionable with worked examples and concrete decision criteria inline.

dimensions.name: Semantic accuracy
dimensions.comment: The name and Chinese description accurately reflect the skill's content, covering architecture patterns, distributed systems, tech selection, and ADR/documentation guidance.

dimensions.name: Examples & edge cases
dimensions.comment: Includes concrete applicability/exclusion lists per architecture style, anti-pattern contrasts, a tech decision template, and sharding/replica diagrams, but lacks a worked end-to-end design example or failure-path walkthrough.

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.comment: The six-phase flow and evaluation criteria are clear, but many steps remain questioning prompts without explicit thresholds, decision rules, or an inline output format (the response templates are deferred to a referenced file).

suggestions: In the six-phase flow and evaluation criteria, convert each questioning prompt into an explicit decision rule with thresholds and pass/fail criteria so users know when to proceed, revise, or stop.
In the six-phase flow, embed the response templates inline at each phase instead of deferring them to a referenced file so the required output format is immediately visible.

In the Examples & edge cases section, add a worked end-to-end design example and a failure-path walkthrough that trace one concrete scenario through the full flow, including trade-offs and error handling.
